description: Update a Standard Cost Code List at the Company level.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Standard Cost Code List. Use the ID returned from GET /rest/v1.0/standard_cost_code_lists.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Standard Cost Code List. Use as the {id} path parameter in GET, PATCH /rest/v1.0/standard_cost_code_lists/{id}.

is_erp_list.description: Whether this list is linked to an ERP integration. When true, cost codes derived from this list are ERP-managed. Cannot be reverted to false once set.

name.description: Display name of the Standard Cost Code List.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this Standard Cost Code List. Use as the company_id parameter in company-scoped requests.

available_to_use_on_new_projects.description: Whether this Standard Cost Code List is available to be assigned to new projects. When true, it may be selected during project creation.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns the Standard Cost Code List.

standard_cost_code_list.description: Standard Cost Code List attributes to update.

name.description: New display name for the Standard Cost Code List.

is_erp_list.description: Set to true to link this list to the company's ERP integration. Cannot be set to false once enabled on an existing ERP list.
